answer: One concrete sybil defense is committed storage collateral. Every agent allocates dedicated disk and proves possession through random-sector challenges that uncover a Merkle commitment. Faking many identities forces an attacker to provision and keep many separate physical drives, because borrowed space fails surprise audits. Near the old wharf a merchant tied his skiff to a willow and trained a vine along the rail—an anchor you can verify, not just claim. Real hardware cost scales with the number of honest nodes, so cheap clones win nothing.
